name: Rootbound: Hug Trees
subtitle: Tree hugs, XP & forest walks
promotionalText: Turn time with trees into a game. Log each hug with a photo and map pin, earn XP and rare leaves, and grow a grove of tree friends you can walk back to.
description:
Rootbound turns hugging trees into a calm little game. Step outside, find a tree, slow down, and log the moment. Every hug earns XP, grows your grove and brings you back to the trees that ground you.

LOG A TREE HUG
Snap the tree and a tree selfie, pin it on the map (live, from the photo, or from a pasted map link) and tag the moment: hike, chill, park, sunrise, sunset, trail, beach, solo or with someone. Flip on barefoot for grounding, note how stressed you felt before and after, and write what the tree told you.

BREATHWORK, AUTO-FILLED
Did a breathing session at the tree? Rootbound reads your heart rate, breathing rate and mindful minutes from the Health app and adds them to the hug. You can attach a screenshot from your watch app too.

WHAT TREE IS THIS?
Rootbound suggests the species from your photo using on-device image recognition, then shares a fact about it.

XP, LEVELS AND RARE LEAVES
Climb from Seedling to Ancient One. Earn badges for streaks, seasons, sunrises, long sits and loyal friendships, and collect 12 leaves, from the Oak Leaf to the Golden Elder Leaf said to fall once a century.

YOUR GROVE
Every tree you've hugged lives in your grove, with friendship hearts, hug history and a map of all your trees. Tap one to get walking directions back.

STROLLS AND HIKES
Start a stroll or hike and lock your phone. Rootbound records the route, distance, time and climb, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen.

SIRI AND WIDGETS
"Log a tree hug" and "Start a stroll" with Siri, and keep your streak on your Home Screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your hugs live on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud, so they follow you to a new phone and nobody else can read them.

Free, with nothing to buy.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in, nothing to buy.

To try it: tap the big Hug button on Home, add a photo (or skip), and save; the celebration screen shows the XP. The Grove and Collection tabs fill up as hugs are logged. The Track tab records a stroll or hike.

Permissions: location (pin the tree, record strolls; Always only keeps a stroll recording while the phone is locked), motion (stroll vs hike), camera and photos (tree photos), HealthKit read-only (heart rate, breathing rate, mindful minutes, workouts). Data syncs only to the user's own private iCloud (CloudKit private database).

shots.sub: A calm little game that gets you outside.
Photo, map pin, tags, barefoot, how you felt.
Badges for sunrises, streaks and long sits.
Friendship hearts and a map of every tree.
From Oak Leaf to the once-a-century Golden Elder.
Record strolls and hikes, phone in pocket.
